title: Emrys and the Salt
author: E. M. Nakamura
blurb: Ines Vane, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
